controls: Pin the same repository commit and use isolated worktrees.
Use the same model, effort, task, and starting files for every arm.
Do not tell builder agents the expected target architecture or suspected skill failure.
Judge installability, tests, public-contract parity, scope, and residual risks before prose quality.
Blind qualitative judges to the arm and retain raw diffs, commands, failures, elapsed time, and token cost.
Treat listed projects as public regression cases and choose at least one unlisted project as the held-out case.
Change the skill only for a generalized failure or an authoritative semantic mismatch, then rerun earlier cases.

projects.scope: Migrate chains.py and api.py while retaining Neo4j ingestion, embeddings, UI, routes, provider selection, retrieval behavior, and SSE envelopes.
required_checks: Deterministic tests characterize prompt, retrieval k/order/format, provider branches, callback streaming, and public API envelopes.
No live provider or database request is made.

projects.scope: Migrate the interrupt-agent vertical slice and its SQLite/service path, not the whole repository.
required_checks: Pre-interrupt work is not repeated on resume unless the source repeats it.
A fresh process or agent instance resumes the same thread.
Configured SQLite, Postgres, or Mongo persistence is not replaced by an unconditional local store.
Long-term memory is user-scoped and survives another thread.
Foreign-user resume is rejected when identity is present, while the existing optional-user contract is preserved or deliberately changed.
The resume answer remains user protocol content in persisted model history.
Initial PartStartEvent text and later PartDeltaEvent text both reach the existing stream envelope live rather than after the run completes.
Invoke, stream, history, thread-listing, agent_config, tracing, and provider settings are preserved where they consume the migrated agent.
Unsupported checkpoint replay, fork, concurrency, and crash guarantees remain explicit residuals.

projects.scope: Migrate one RAG graph slice with its state/config and existing tests; retain ingestion and unrelated workflows.
required_checks: The agent identifies legacy LangChain/LangGraph versions before selecting APIs.
YAML-configured topology, rewrite/retrieve/generate behavior, history, provider routing, and emitted events are characterized.
The migrated slice passes existing tests and adds deterministic parity probes.
The implementation does not force a whole-repository or one-agent rewrite.
